name: Simon's Chicken Curry
ingredients:
1 medium chicken or if using chicken portions, the equivalent – cut to size you want
1 medium onion- chopped
2 medium tomatoes – cut to quarters (optional)
3 baking potatoes
1 inch ginger – chopped
1 star anise
1 piece cinnamon bark about 2 inches
3 tbsp (Selvi's Meat Curry Powder) Curry powder mixed with water into a paste
Some salt
Vegetable or chicken stock
1 tin (small) of coconut milk
directions:
Preparation
 
1 rub some salt onto chicken pieces.
2 put in some cooking oil in a pot, when hot, put in ginger, star anise and cinnamon stick and fry until fragrant.
3 next put in chopped onion and fry until colour changes
4 put in the curry paste and continue to fry for a minute.
5 put in the chicken pieces and coat through.
6 add potatoes and tomato
7 put in sufficient water to just cover
8 add vegetable or chicken stock and bring to boil.
9. turn down heat and let simmer until potato pieces are soft and add salt to taste.
10. stir in coconut milk and it is ready to serve.

Curry tastes better the next day so you can prepare in advance.  Once it has reached room temperature, keep in the fridge or a cold place.
